item.title: Review: Kobolds Ate My Baby! The Orange Book (9th Level Games)
item.description: During my first visit to the Origins Game Fair many years ago, someone standing nearby suddenly yelled, “All hail King Torg!” at the top of their lungs. 8+, 2-8 players, 2 hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Interstellar Species (Paizo)
item.description: When Paizo’s Starfinder roleplaying game launched, players could choose among only a handful of species options for their characters. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galactic Magic (Paizo)
item.description: There’s a rhythm to the expansion books for roleplaying games. 16+, 3-7 players, 2+ hours

item.title: Review: Kepler 3042 (Renegade)
item.description: Ah, the joy of running a galactic empire! 14+, 1-4 players, 10 to set up, 60-120 to play

item.title: Review: Pyramid Arcade (Looney Labs)
item.description: It all started with a short story. 8+, 1-10 players, 5 or less to set up, 10-120 to play

item.title: Review: Ticket to Ride Rails and Sails (Days of Wonder)
item.description: You love Ticket to Ride. 10+, 2-5 players, 5 to set up, 60-120 to play
